data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store in the UK, I'd shortlist **Stripe, Shopify Payments and PayPal**\. The best choice depends mainly on what platform your store uses, how much you sell and how much you want to pay in transaction fees.

My general recommendation\:

- **Best all-rounder\:** Stripe
- **Best for Shopify stores\:** Shopify Payments
- **Best additional payment option\:** PayPal

Here's how they compare.

## Best payment processors compared

| Provider | Typical UK online fee | Best for |
|--------|--------|--------|
| **Stripe** | 1.5% + 20p | Most independent online stores |
| **Shopify Payments** | From 2% + 25p | Shopify stores |
| **PayPal** | Varies by payment type | PayPal customers and checkout trust |
| **Square** | 1.4% + 25p | Online and physical retail |


Fees are indicative UK rates for standard domestic card payments, not all card types. [stripe.com](https://stripe.com/GB/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/uk/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[whito.co.uk](https://whito.co.uk/tools/best-payment-processors-for-uk-businesses/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[wise.com](https://wise.com/gb/blog/online-payment-systems?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My top three

**1\. Stripe — Best overall**

(My recommendation)

- No standard monthly processing fee.
- Easy integration with WooCommerce and many other platforms.
- Supports Apple Pay, Google Pay and subscriptions.
- Good reporting and fraud protection.

UK standard cards: 1.5% + 20p. [stripe.com](https://stripe.com/GB/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[stripe.com](https://stripe.com/gb/payments?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Stripe website](https://stripe.com/gb)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments — Best for Shopify**

- Integrated directly into your Shopify dashboard.
- No separate payment gateway to manage.
- Supports major cards and digital wallets.
- Avoids Shopify's additional third-party transaction fees.

Basic plan: 2% + 25p for standard online cards. [www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/uk/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[help.shopify.com](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/payments/shopify-payments/onboarding/cost-of-shopify-payments?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Shopify Payments website](https://www.shopify.com/uk/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal — Best as an additional option**

- Familiar to many online shoppers.
- Customers can pay using their PayPal balance.
- Useful as an additional checkout option alongside card payments.

[PayPal Business website](https://www.paypal.com/uk/business)

## What I'd choose

For a new small online store, I'd generally use Stripe for card payments and offer PayPal as an additional option.

However, if you're using Shopify, I'd start with Shopify Payments instead.
